title: King Bed•Kinky Hideaway•Exclusive•Cozy•Seductive
description:
Escape & Indulge to this adults-only studio in Nashville, designed for couples seeking a playful getaway. Enjoy a king bed, cozy bathroom, full sized kitchen with all spaces full of amenities. Behind the locked oversized closet, discover LED lighting, his-and-hers robes, body paints, adult play toys, adult swing, games, memorabilia &  more. With black lights & a disco ball, this unique space sets the mood for an unforgettable stay. Rain or shine the party goes on!!!

The space
✨ Welcome to The Bunny Den, Your Private Escape ✨

Step into an oversized studio designed for comfort, pleasure, & total relaxation. This spacious hideaway features a full kitchen with seating for four, a complete bathroom stocked with thoughtful amenities, & an expansive bedroom lounge with a king-sized bed, cozy seating, a sofa, a TV, games, & reading materials for those slow, peaceful moments.

You’ll also enjoy full access to a private washer and dryer, making longer stays effortless.

And then… there’s the special place.
Tucked behind its own locked door lies a fully equipped, extra-exclusive experience created just for you. Whether you’re traveling with kids, family, or friends, or you simply want to indulge in something memorable & exciting, this locked private area lets you keep the magic private & all to yourself.

From the moment you step inside, The Bunny Den becomes your personal oasis, a playful, intimate, & luxurious retreat made to spark joy, relaxation, & moments you won’t forget.

Private hot tub room on the property by reservation only @ $40 per night (fcfs). If you’re booking only for the use of the hot tub PLEASE confirm its availability prior to booking your stay as they’re no refunds because it’s not available after you book. 

Your escape begins here. 🩷✨

Guest access
When you arrive, you’ll have full & private access to your space. You’ll enjoy your own private entrance & a dedicated parking spot, with additional parking available if needed. There are neighbors upstairs that can be a bit heavy footed at times. Unfortunately the builder cut some corners there.

Other things to note
Please note: Hot tub is by fcfs reservation only & at a nightly rate of $40.
